summary: curate honors --data-source: local never calls the live API, live skips the store, and auto keeps the store-first path but prints one stderr line when it falls back to the live OpenAlex search. Stdout is unchanged.
reason: The live fallback ran whenever the store returned nothing, even under --data-source local, and said nothing. Live search covers title, abstract and full text and is a billed search request, so callers got rows of a different kind than the store returns without knowing it. Callers must be able to forbid it and to see when it happened.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ -run Curate asserts local never calls live, live never opens the store, and auto falls back with the notice only on an empty store result. On a real Lancet mirror, local "ai diagnosis" went from 100 live rows to 0; other topics unchanged.
